name: 10523 · Elmsford, NY
findings: ZIP 10523 (Elmsford) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10523 (Elmsford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
